watch.theme: Bank leadership may be nearing fatigue, but no handoff is confirmed
watch.thesis: Banks remain the prevailing, cohesive leader, yet crowding is high and Coal sits close behind. Rotation is narrow, while Coal’s weak breadth and mean-reverting character make it insufficient evidence of succession.
